doc.title: Hide Tanaka interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014

title: Listening to Milt Hinton's slap bass
summary: A recording is played and Tanaka identifies Milt Hinton; he never met him.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: I wanted to play a brief piece of music for you, to see what you think of it:
Oh, this is — he’s a good photographer too. Yes, slap bass. Milt Hinton.
To me the bass player, when you don’t have a drummer, the bass player becomes the drummer too. Did you ever get to meet Milt Hinton?
